package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for response_dto_contains_gorm_tags: Response payload structs that carry persistence-only `gorm` tags.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type InvoiceResponse struct {
	ID         int     `json:"id" gorm:"primaryKey"`
	CustomerID int     `json:"customer_id" gorm:"column:customer_id"`
	Amount     float64 `json:"amount" gorm:"column:amount_due"`
	Status     string  `json:"status" gorm:"column:invoice_status"`
}

func GetInvoiceHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	resp := InvoiceResponse{
		ID:         1001,
		CustomerID: 42,
		Amount:     299.99,
		Status:     "pending",
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}
